# Infused Agency

> Boutique SEO, AI search and web design agency based in St. Catharines, Ontario, Canada. Infused helps owner-run businesses in trades, professional practices, hospitality and related service industries get found in Google Search, Google Maps and AI-generated answers, and turn that visibility into calls and enquiries. Services include SEO (local and technical), AI search optimization (GEO/AEO/LLM SEO), and conversion-focused web design and development. Works remotely with clients across Canada and the United States.

Infused is deliberately small — the person you speak with stays close to the work from consultation through launch and reporting. Work is planned as a system (SEO, AI search and web design together), with measurement tied to enquiries (calls, quote requests, bookings) rather than vanity traffic. Pricing is quoted individually after a free consultation. No rankings, AI citations or lead counts are guaranteed — outcomes depend on factors outside the agency's control.

## Core Services

- [SEO](https://infused.agency/seo): Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, service and location pages, technical SEO and internal linking. AI search visibility is treated as an extension of the same work.
- [AI Search (GEO, AEO & LLM SEO)](https://infused.agency/ai-search): Makes a business clear, consistent and quotable so AI assistants and answer engines can describe and recommend it accurately.
- [Web Design & Development](https://infused.agency/web-design): Conversion-focused, SEO-aware websites for businesses across Canada and the United States, scoped and quoted individually.
- [Website Conversion Rate Optimization](https://infused.agency/website-conversion-optimization): Audits, user research, testing and refinements to turn existing traffic into enquiries.
- [WordPress Development (Niagara)](https://infused.agency/wordpress-developer-niagara): WordPress builds for Niagara/St. Catharines businesses with training and post-launch support.

## Industries & Specializations

- [SEO by Industry](https://infused.agency/industries): Industry-specific SEO programmes built around how each sector gets found.
- [SEO for Therapists in Canada](https://infused.agency/therapist-seo): SEO built specifically for counselling, psychotherapy and psychology practices, with province and city pages across all ten Canadian provinces. [US Therapist SEO](https://infused.agency/therapist-seo/usa) covers select New York State cities.
- [SEO for Concrete Contractors in Canada](https://infused.agency/seo/for-concrete-contractors): Canada-wide programme with city pages across major markets.
- [General Contractor SEO in Canada](https://infused.agency/general-contractor-seo): Province and city-level coverage for renovation/building businesses.

## Case Studies & Results

- [Results](https://infused.agency/results): Documented client outcomes. Published examples include Flat Rock Cellars (+100% local visibility, 400+ keywords ranked across Google Search/Maps and AI answers within three months), Brandi May Psychotherapy and Willow Creek Counselling (600+ keywords each with reported increased visibility/bookings), Pro Battery Shop (400+ keywords, growth in organic ranking within three months), Timberwolf Carpentry (450+ keywords, thousands of impressions), and Fred's Concrete (500+ keywords, more visibility and leads).
- [Cass-A-Bella Construction](https://infused.agency/cass-a-bella-construction): Website redesign case study for a custom home builder with reported growth in views and leads.
